summary: Markets enter the final week of August in consolidation mode after consumer sentiment and retail sales data disappointed earlier this week, pushing the S&P 500 down from record highs. Intel completed a massive $23 billion equity raise via a 242 million-share placement that the market absorbed without major damage, netting the chipmaker cash to fund foundry ambitions amid negative free cash flow. Traders are focused on Wednesday's FOMC minutes for clues on the Fed's September stance after recent economic softness eased rate-hike fears. Crypto markets remain under pressure despite softer inflation prints earlier this week, with Bitcoin hovering near $63,000 and Ethereum around $1,880 as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and lack of clear catalysts weigh on sentiment. Goldman Sachs expanded its crypto footprint with a $2.25 billion acquisition of NEOS Investments, bringing nearly $1 billion in Bitcoin ETF assets under management and signaling Wall Street's deepening institutional commitment to digital assets.

signals.title: Consumer Sentiment and Retail Sales Miss Dent Recovery Narrative
signals.desc: Declines in consumer sentiment and retail sales overshadowed Fed pause optimism, pushing the S&P 500 down 0.2% from all-time highs and raising concerns about Corporate America's growth engine.

signals.title: Intel Completes $23B Equity Raise Without Major Selloff
signals.desc: Intel's 242 million-share offering closed at $102.50, holding a 7.9% premium to the $95 offer price, providing capital for foundry expansion despite 4.8% dilution.

signals.title: Fed Minutes on Wednesday to Guide September Rate Path
signals.desc: Gold and silver traders are focused on Wednesday's FOMC minutes amid uncertainty over the Fed's next move, with rates and geopolitical risk premium competing for direction.

signals.title: Crypto Prices Slip Despite Softer Inflation Data
signals.desc: Bitcoin and Ethereum are failing to hold gains from cooler CPI readings, with BTC near $63,000 and ETH at $1,880 as Middle East tensions and lack of fresh catalysts limit upside.

signals.title: Goldman Sachs Acquires $2.25B NEOS for Crypto Exposure
signals.desc: Goldman's acquisition of NEOS Investments brings nearly $1 billion in Bitcoin High Income ETF assets, marking a major Wall Street commitment to structured crypto products.

verdict: Markets await Wednesday's FOMC minutes for direction as consumer weakness battles Fed pause hopes, while crypto treads water despite institutional inflows.
